mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP450 enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9), reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its clearance, while chlorpromazine may inhibit phenobarbital metabolism; additive CNS depression occurs.
action: Monitor for reduced chlorpromazine efficacy and adjust dose accordingly; assess for excessive CNS depression; consider alternative antiepileptic agents.
